ActionReaction.triggered_lineage_uuid: Null if the native trigger is undisclosed; preserve admitted reaction outcome.
AvailableSelectionPreview.selected_route: Native-selected route/cost/endpoint from the same decision used for execution; never client pathfinding.
CombatLogAppend.encounter_log_index: Audience-local append index, not original global log index.
CombatLogEntry.data: Replace Dict[str,Any] at its existing owner with the finite tagged log-data union; keep native roll values and projected privacy omissions.
CombatLogEntry.perceiver_uuids: Private event-time grants: excluded from outgoing serialization, not an empty public grant map.
CombatLogEntry.revealed_entity_uuids: Private event-time evidence: excluded from outgoing serialization.
ConditionFact.event_uuid: Null for reacquired condition whose application was not observed; condition identity and current state survive.
ConditionState.applied_source_event_curs: Map to disclosed occurrence order; null for an unobserved application, preserving quiet reacquisition.
ConditionState.duration: Passive admitted native duration summary; null when unknown. Captured by BaseCondition.snapshot_state and refreshed through existing actor/HUD capture, never client ticking.
ContentAttribution.dispatch_index: Order among admitted handler dispatches only; no gaps from hidden handlers.
ContentAttribution.triggering_event_uuid: Null unless occurrence admitted; provided_by/origin refs require admitted descriptor closure.
ItemEffectPresentationState.applied_sour: Same admitted occurrence remap as ConditionState; null if origin undisclosed.
ItemEffectPresentationState.duration: Reuse ConditionDurationSummary for admitted item-effect duration; no separate clock.
MultiEntityLogData.per_target_logs: Remove duplicate copies of child data. Ordered sub_entries is the single child-detail representation.
MultiEntityLogData.target_entry_indices: Ordered membership references into sub_entries, including repeated applications; filter/renumber after audience admission. Counts/saves/damage use these children only, never auxiliary events.
ObservedChangeRef.source_index: Audience-local occurrence index, paired with admitted source_event_uuid; omit reference if its occurrence is undisclosed.
PerceivedSpatialEffect.duration: Reuse ConditionDurationSummary for admitted spatial duration; remembered effects retain last observed duration.
PerceivedSpatialEffect.owner_revision: Audience-local effect-state revision; hidden changes do not advance it.
PlayerCharacterSheet.handler_details: Add the existing AvailableHandlerInfo values to recorded own-character after-state; no duplicate handler type.
PlayerHUDSnapshot.revision: Audience-local admitted HUD revision; invisible activity does not advance it.
PlayerLineage.end_cursor: Audience-local occurrence boundary, not SSE sequence or native event cursor.
PlayerLineage.lineage_uuid: Public causal-group identity; native root identity only if admitted, otherwise an opaque audience-local grouping identity.
PlayerLineage.root: Nullable when native root is not disclosed; do not invent a visible root or leak its hidden header.
PlayerLineage.start_cursor: Audience-local occurrence boundary, not SSE sequence or native event cursor.
PlayerNode.children_lineages: Only disclosed child groups; never hidden IDs or a hidden child-count placeholder.
PlayerNode.parent_event: Only disclosed occurrence reference; otherwise null. Hidden ancestors are not serialized as factless technical chains.
PlayerNode.parent_lineage: Only disclosed causal reference; otherwise null.
PlayerNode.turn_execution_id: Null unless this turn execution is disclosed; never a hidden-turn correlation ID.
PlayerOperation.audience: Required current authorized group after-value; one socket covers all assigned units. Selection of a body does not change the audience.
StepMovementLogData.path_index: Index within the disclosed movement segment; hidden prefix length is not transmitted.
TurnLogData.turn_index: Position in this audience's admitted initiative order, or null when unknown; not objective initiative index.
VersionRow.source_index: Audience-local occurrence order; raw native index is private.
wire.additionalProperties: All reachable fixed records reject unknown properties in the serialized contract; existing typed maps retain typed keys/values. Apply the same strictness at existing owner or public schema boundary, never strip extras silently.
wire.integers: Safe signed 53-bit values, nonnegative local ordering/selection indices. Native integer domains remain native; fail export on overflow, never clamp.
wire.log_omissions: Explicit per-variant admission omissions in LOG_OMISSIONS; source capture keeps its complete record, same projection owner constructs permitted values.
wire.log_tags: Existing LogData owners gain literal kind tags; category compatibility is checked, not another API wrapper per log variant.
